changes: The library toolbar is cleaner: the old stored-ROM paragraph is gone, Add ROM shows the current cartridge count in both views, and the table action stays at the far right.
The table/detail control is now one compact tabletop button, the table close action has the same hover feedback as the other drawers, and wide screens no longer move the console unnecessarily.
LCD contrast controls no longer repeat a technical baseline sentence underneath the slider, leaving the option row easier to scan.
The README now starts with a plain accuracy table, uses the latest screenshots, and explains exactly why Gambatte's revision-limited diagnostic run is not a strict score.
The local verification remains stable at 99/99 project tests, 70/70 applicable Mooneye checks, and no conformance timeouts.
The controlled SameSuite matrix remains 60/76 for GAMEBOY LAB and 65/76 for SameBoy 1.0.3; failures and unsupported hardware are listed instead of hidden.
The nine-trial core-only smoke medians remain 792.70 FPS for DMG Tetris and 665.75 FPS for CGB Tetris DX; game timing is unchanged.
